name: scenario_c_island
title: The island
about: Golden hour, from RTS heights. The map's own flag island in the west swamp is a quiet red camp: two red robots lie on loungers by two campfires, the flag is red, the gun crewed, a laser squad on the north shore and a pyro squad in the camp, all holding their places. Blue robots step off the east bank and wade the crocodiles' channel under the guard's fire; crocodiles take three of them on the way (the slow roll, the fast dive, the slow roll); the loungers get up as the blue come near, and the survivors land and fight the guard (lasers, pyros, the gun). Every shot looks from the south side, so the lasers on the north shore are seen firing side-on, never from behind.
